name: Durnan Furcutter
summary: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Durnan Furcutter outfits young dwarves and gnomes for the mountain cold. He sells light clothing and leather goods from inside the settlement.

sections.title: A Warm Stitch in the Cold
sections.body: Inside Anvilmar, young dwarves and exiled gnomes prove themselves. Some need more freedom of movement than heavy iron allows. Durnan Furcutter sells light, pliable layers to scouts, rogues, and spellcasters who want to stay agile in Dun Morogh's bitter winds. Near the hearth, he offers everyday tailoring and stitched leather. He claims his stock is the finest in the valley.

sections.title: A Mug in Hand
sections.body: Durnan likes a strong drink as much as an honest trade. To warm himself against the freezing draft, he orders steaming mugs of Scalding Mornbrew from Nori Pridedrift, who sells the brew piping hot across Coldridge Valley. Adventurers hurrying through the valley with errands often bring Durnan a hot mug before it cools. Then they carry the empty back to Nori.

faq.answer: Durnan Furcutter sells basic cloth and leather gear to novice adventurers setting out in Dun Morogh. He is a dwarven clothier and leather merchant at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: Where can I find Durnan Furcutter?
faq.answer: You can find Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, near the training masters and local tradesfolk.
Durnan sells introductory cloth and leather armor for adventurers who depend on agility or spellcasting instead of heavy mail.

faq.q: Why is he involved with Scalding Mornbrew deliveries?
faq.answer: Durnan works long hours in Coldridge Valley's icy winds. He orders hot Scalding Mornbrew from Nori Pridedrift, who sells it across the valley, to stay warm and sharp.

angles.text: As a dwarf in Coldridge Valley, you see Durnan's practical craft and his fondness for a hot brew. His friendly banter carries through the snow.
As a budding tailor, you can learn from Durnan's basic garments. They help keep scouts and apprentices alive in the snowy passes before mastercrafted cloth takes over.
